claims: The actual four compiled GS address helper functions match the public table oracle in2359296 synthetic cases over specified full two-by-two-page coordinate domains, buffer widths and six block bases, with no reported undefined-behavior sanitizer diagnostic.

The one-bit output mutant causes a mismatch for every2359296 compared address. Both binary invocations return0 because they dump computed addresses; mismatch acceptance/rejection is performed by the Python oracle assertions.
This experiment establishes only bounded address arithmetic parity, not memory transfers, palette loading, rendering, timing, device or game equivalence.
